equity.equity_measurement: School poverty is proxied by the share of students eligible for FRPM (low ≤25%, mid 26–75%, high ≥76%). School locale (city/suburb/town/rural) is rurality of schools, a non-human unit, so it is not treated as an SPD.

notes: The design is inferred as cross-sectional from one wave of a longitudinal school survey. Locale comparisons (4 groups, all pairs tested) are recorded only in comparison because school rurality was not treated as an SPD. If it is an SPD, it adds a pairwise (all pairs) groupwise entry with n_groups 4.
view_issues: The Summary says 'high-efficiency particular air'. A footnote warns that chi-square significance may coexist with overlapping CIs. The text uses ≥76% for high poverty while the Table 3 note uses >75%; these are equivalent.
